definitions.full: H6741. Tsillah צִלָּה proper name, feminine wife of Lam. Gen 4:19 , 22 , 23 , Σελλα .

occurrences.englishText: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
